lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct longitudinal rows. The spacing between centroids is relatively uniform in the mid-flank, with a notable triangular cluster of three blobs located immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes most visible in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally. These features are defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition, with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and localized shadowing on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible surface of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 mid-intensity blobs, primarily concentrated toward the base and trailing edge of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor structural irregularities and small indentations are visible along the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-density field of micro-blobs, significantly smaller in diameter than the flank constellations, is concentrated on the rostrum and the dorsal surface of the head anterior to the gill slits.
